title: Narrow as a Doorway

mood.label: Heavy, with openings
mood.summary: A heavy day with narrow openings: Hormuz stays closed, a Russian refinery burns, 27 killed in South Kordofan and 15 newborns lost to a hospital fire — while a papal envoy met Lavrov and a first central-retina transplant restored a woman's sight.

style.genre: organ-led downtempo hymn — oboe, upright bass, brushes

lines: The Strait stays shut whatever Oman signed,
a refinery burns four hundred miles from the front.
Kordofan counts twenty-seven, Myanmar hits a floor,
and in Islamabad the nursery didn't hold.
Still a Vatican car pulled up to Lavrov's door,
first time in four years anyone bothered to knock.
A woman woke with a stranger's retina and saw,
and the sleep they only dulled has a drug at last.
Forty-five and heavy, but the light gets in —
narrow as a doorway, wide as a given eye.
Hold the whole day honest, the fire and the seam,
oil going down, somebody learning to see.
